note: Main campground of Hearst San Simeon SP, along San Simeon Creek just east of Hwy 1 near Cambria; a trail runs under the highway bridge to the beach. RV pads run about 25-26 ft on ReserveCalifornia. Showers are token-operated; some toilets may be chemical. Portions of the campground were closed in late November 2026, with reservations moved to other sites (park alert, 2026-11-27). --Claude
summary: parks.ca.gov + ReserveCalifornia API + imagery read. 134 sites, max 35 ft (pads ~25-26 ft); no electric; flush toilets, token showers, dump + water fill; year-round; max stay 10; $35 (2027). Partial closure alert (reservations relocated) - status open. Not waterfront holds. Phone -> 805-927-2035.
